title: Within This Body-fortress Is The Lord
summary: Mercy is named plainly here before the mind has time to decorate it.
takeaway: Within this body-fortress is the Lord, the Sovereign Lord King, but the stubborn ones do not find the taste
lifeApplication: Receive one line as mercy before turning it into a performance review. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.
